headline: Three blockers threaten the go-live date

bullets.text: Critical defect backlog stands at 34, more than double the plan assumption
sub: Root cause: legacy field mappings not documented in the source system

bullets.text: Test environment access for the vendor team is limited to business hours
sub: Adds roughly two days to every test cycle

bullets.text: UAT entry criteria have not been signed off by the business owner

annotation: Clearing the defect backlog is the single highest-leverage action available this month.
